note.text: Single summary-delivery Task at Interaction 4 (contrast UC03's two simultaneous delivery Tasks). It routes the encounter summary + care plan from Barton Springs back to the originating teledentistry provider (Meridian Teledental) via Da Vinci CDex provider-to-provider push — direct, no HIE hub, no 360X bridge. Distinct from the referral Task (task-referral-tracking), which closes to outcome-final at the same moment.
